action.objective: :Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4; identify tactical resources, king-safety risks, and best candidate.
action.rationale: :Broad depth-4 search over all legal moves completed at depth 2 (node cutoff), finding a8a7 best (383, exact, pv a8a7 c8d7) and a1b1 second (308, exact). a8a7 improves queen safety away from c8 bishop's diagonal and the b2 pawn, though b2 pawn promotion threat to b1q remains a lurking danger. a8a6 and a8c8 scored lower with upper bounds, while a1d1 had an upper bound that could hide worse play. Reserved verification is on a8a7. I will verify a8a7 with the reserved node allowance to check for tactical refutations and confirm it is commit-ready.
